sections.title: Contributors to population change in Copeland
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Copeland, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 3,389 people (−5.0%). In total, there were 5,236 births and 8,624 deaths in Copeland between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 1,738 (2.6%). There were 20,794 people entering the area and 19,056 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Copeland of 285 people (−0.4%), as a result of 1,056 people entering the area and 1,342 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Copeland's population of 617 (0.9%).as a result of 1,275 people entering the area and 659 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
